title: Make standalone gateway current-slot helper honor slots-per-superframe
description: P3 correctness/API invariant: rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs current_slot_from_timestamp(timestamp, duration_s, start) returns elapsed seconds modulo duration and has no slots_per_superframe parameter. It is only a slot index when every slot is exactly one second; the same module's validated SuperframeConfig supports arbitrary duration_s/slots_per_superframe and correctly scales . Calling the public standalone helper for e.g. 60 seconds/240 slots returns 0..59 instead of 0..239 and can schedule transmission in the wrong quarter of the superframe. Remove/deprecate the inconsistent helper or accept validated slot dimensions and share the SuperframeConfig calculation; add non-1-second-slot vectors and reject timestamps before the configured epoch rather than silently saturating if the protocol requires synchronized time.
